title: Album Open
description: A library of twelve Beatles albums. Open one and its cover flies out of the grid into the header while the tracklist staggers in with real song lengths; scroll and the header shrinks until the cover flies again into the top bar, and Back sends it home.
intent: One cover that is never replaced: the same element travels grid to header to bar and back on a sprung shared layout, and every leg can be caught and reversed mid-flight.
